newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 295,500 MT were 4 percent below the previous week and 12 percent under the 4-week average. Major increases for South Korea (110,000 MT), Mexico (75,700 MT), Israel (65,500 MT), and Japan (36,200 MT) were partially offset by reductions for unknown destinations (33,200 MT).
Sales of 98,000 MT for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were for unknown destinations (68,000 MT) and France (30,000 MT).

Exports of 443,000 MT were one-half above the previous week and exceeded the 4-week average by 7 percent. The primary destinations were South Korea (90,000 MT), Japan (85,900 MT), Mexico (85,500 MT), Taiwan (53,500 MT), and the Netherlands (46,300 MT).
